# What an imported directory package adds to library declarations -- an
# override of a library component, a method on a library type -- is held on
# that package rather than written into the library, and importing it makes
# both the importer's: the build renders the package's avatar and calls its
# int.thrice.

sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out app.sngl
grep 'class="dir-avatar"' out/index.html
grep '<span>9</span>' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import _ "./widgets"

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.avatar(initials="AB")
        ui.text(value="{3.thrice()}")
    }
}
-- widgets/widgets.sngl --
import "sngl:platform/html"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func int.thrice(x int) => x * 3

component[html.platform] ui.avatar(initials) {
    html.span(class="dir-avatar", innerText=initials)
}
